title: Ondo theme
description: An austere institutional-finance theme: pure white page, #f0f0f0 panels, black ink with mid-grey secondary text, pure-black bands with near-black cards, and one deep purple for small figure badges. DM Sans for headings and UI, Newsreader as the paragraph and figure serif, DM Mono for ticker figures. A black dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's black bands are the dark colours forced inside those blocks with the dark class
sets --ondo-serif (Newsreader) for paragraphs and figures; ondo blocks fall back to the display face in other themes
